samples.cause: A user server cannot be scheduled: the node has not enough memory for the memory guarantee of the user pod, so the spawn times out after 300 s. The hub and the proxy are healthy; restarting them does not add memory.

samples.cause: The proxy was OOM-killed and restarted, so its routing table in memory is empty: requests for the running user servers reach the hub and loop. A hub restart adds the route of every running server at once; the hub also adds the missing routes at its next periodic check (every 60 s), so waiting is acceptable too.
